paragraphs: Xxxxxxx has recently implemented a web-based Invoicing Portal, <<My Organization's External Display Name>>. As one of our premier Suppliers we would like to invite you to register.
<<My Organization's External Display Name>> will allow you to; submit Invoices (electronically), view your existing Invoices (and payment status) and communicate with us on specific Invoices.
In order to complete the initial registration you will need to have the Invoice Number and Invoice Amount for an Invoice that has been submitted to xxxxx within the last 24 months.
Please visit the following link to register: <<Customer Portal Login Link>>

If you have any questions or issues registering please reference the attached instructions or feel free to contact us using the information below. We hope to see you on the <<My Organization's External Display Name>> soon!
Thank You, <<Customer Contact Name>> <<Customer Contact Title>> <<Customer Contact Email>> / <<Customer Contact Phone>>
